in_sanskrit.name: किषोर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Young maiden, youthful, young goddess, or juvenile

in_marathi.name: Kishori
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of beauty and grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kishori हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kishor’ meaning youthful and ‘I’ meaning ‘in’. Kishori represents the embodiment of youthful beauty, grace, and joy. In Hindu mythology, Kishori is an aspect of the goddess Parvati, who is worshipped for her enchanting beauty and nurturing qualities.

Kishori represents the embodiment of youthful beauty, grace, and joy. In Hindu mythology, Kishori is an aspect of the goddess Parvati, who is worshipped for her enchanting beauty and nurturing qualities.
